rules.statement: An action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code for a debt of Rs. 39.95 should have been brought in the Court of Requests, regardless of the value of the land involved.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, that as the value of the right that the plaintiff was seeking to establish was Rs. 39 . 95 , his action under section 247 should have been brought in the Court of Requests, although the value of the land affected was in excess of the jurisdiction of such Court.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code
